items.title: National Space Policy and International Cooperation in an Era of Rising Techno-Nationalism
items.meta: Researcher · Future Space Research Center, Ministry of Science and ICT · May 2022–Dec 2026
items.summary: Analyzes space-policy trends and technological competition among major countries through the lens of techno-nationalism, and explores the implications of satellite navigation and satellite technologies for global sustainable development from the perspective of international technology cooperation. The project also supports the development of interdisciplinary technology-policy specialists through collaboration among participating universities.
items.note: Sejong University (lead), KAIST, Seoul National University, Yonsei University, and Hongik University.

items.title: Emerging Technologies and Emerging Security Issues
items.summary: Analyzed the security implications of AI, quantum, biotechnology, and nanotechnology and compared policy approaches in the United States, European Union, and China. The project proposed risk-based, multi-level governance linking domestic regulation with bilateral and multilateral cooperation, and contributed to policy-report preparation and expert sessions on responsible AI, cybersecurity, and emerging-security governance.
